name: braintrust
summary: I successfully installed the Braintrust SDK and dependencies (`pip install braintrust openai autoevals` reported "Successfully installed autoevals-0.3.0 braintrust-0.34.0"). I also created the `movie_matcher.py` eval script exactly per the quickstart docs, using `Eval` with `ExactMatch` scorer and five movie plot test cases. However, the sandbox environment blocks outbound HTTPS to `api.braintrust.dev` — both `curl -v https://api.braintrust.dev/v1/status` and the Python SDK fail with `Recv failure: Connection reset by peer` during the TLS handshake. Because the eval cannot reach Braintrust's API to log the experiment, the promised outcome (an eval run executed via the SDK with scores reported) is blocked by this network restriction. I also could not install the `bt` CLI for the same reason (`curl -fsSL https://bt.dev/cli/install.sh` hit the same connection reset).
